title: Product of Array Except Self
prompt: Given an integer array `nums`, return an array `answer` where `answer[i]` is the product of all elements of `nums` except `nums[i]`. You must write an algorithm that runs in O(n) time without using division.
constraints: The product of any prefix or suffix fits in a 32-bit integer.
hints: Since you can't use division, think about prefix and suffix products.
Build an array of prefix products (product of everything to the left of i).
Then sweep from the right multiplying in a running suffix product to combine with each prefix.
